title: Blinding, CLOE and covariance
author: Cail Daley
description: Slides for the Paris CMBX SWG meeting: how the Euclid groups blind DR1 and what CMBX has to decide, the CLOE versus dr1_cmbx likelihood comparison on TR1 chains, what CMBX needs for its covariance, and the SPT lensing-estimator trend in the κ crosses.

sections.title: Opening
sections.outline: Title, index of the parts, and the paper this work is for.

sections.title: Blinding
sections.outline: Who blinds what in Euclid DR1, how large the CMBX blind should be, whether κκ is blinded, comparing blinded vectors across groups, and questions for the room.

sections.title: CLOE vs dr1_cmbx
sections.outline: The same TR1 chains with CLOE and with the dr1_cmbx exact likelihood: posteriors, bias against the mock truth, cost. Production now samples CLOE directly through a JAX port.

sections.title: Covariance needs
sections.outline: What CMBX uses now, which covariance blocks it needs from whom, and the open choices.

sections.title: SPT estimator trend
sections.outline: The S8 shift between SPT-3G lensing estimators in the κ crosses, against Ouellette et al., and its band-level reading.
